mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate tighter policy.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above 12-month average; p-value of return difference > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
failure_condition: In contractionary labor periods (UNRATE rising), 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 (goods orders) followed by a 5-day horizon positive S&P 500 forward return reflects anticipatory equity price adjustment to stronger demand.
failure_condition: No positive 5-day returns when GDPC1 shows no trend or declines, across multiple consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers without corresponding S&P 500 forward return reversal in 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS (reserves) below the 6-month moving average indicate a liquidity squeeze, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as risk aversion falls.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns when RSAFS remains above 6-month average for 30 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 5% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightness boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when UNRATE remains above 5% for 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in HOUST (household spending) and GDPC1 (goods orders) over the prior month produce a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via dual demand channels.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies show no upward movement or only one increases.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in INDPRO (industrial production) for three consecutive months combined with a FEDFUNDS rise results in a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as supply contraction outweighs rate easing.
failure_condition: No negative returns when INDPRO recovers or FEDFUNDS falls during the same window.
